pages.text: The $(thing)dipole$() is the classic HF antenna: a $(item)1:1 balun$() with two level wires going opposite ways, each a quarter wave long. It is matched on one band.$(br2)The $(thing)inverted V$() is a dipole hung from one tall support: both arms slope down from the balun, 5% shorter, at 90 degrees or wider. A little weaker.

pages.name: A 20 m dipole
pages.text: Wire from the balun to each pole, 5 blocks each side. Solar panels, controller and battery power it.
The $(thing)end-fed$() is a dipole with only one arm: one quarter-wave wire from a 1:1 balun. Easier to string, not as good.
pages.title: End-fed
